items.title: Is red-hot Norrie now favourite to win Montreal? Brit dumps out third seed De Minaur
items.description: Five years on from winning his biggest title in Indian Wells, Britain's Cameron Norrie has found his form to dump out third seed Alex de Minaur and reach the fourth round of the National Bank Open in Montreal.

items.title: Barron scores hat-trick as Hull FC end losing run with win over St Helens
items.description: Winger Harvey Barron scored a first senior hat-trick as Hull FC ended a seven-game losing run with a 32-18 comeback win at St Helens.

items.title: Hearts humbled by Benfica as Hibs secure vital win; Motherwell held in Helsinki
items.description: Hearts endured a predictably bruising evening in Lisbon as their hopes of progressing to the Europa League were all but ended by a 6-1 thrashing at the hands of Benfica.

items.title: Old habits haunt Rangers in early McInnes tenure
items.description: Derek McInnes says Rangers were "guilty of beating ourselves" as he bemoaned the loss of cheap goals in the Europa League qualifying first-leg defeat to Jagiellonia Bialystok in Poland.
